answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade, tied to a verified device-bound key. A lantern registry publishes each key stake and reputation, so one operator cannot spin up thousands of cheap identities without locking capital per identity. New identities start through a narrow inlet of trust: low transaction limits that widen only after sustained honest work, while a sudden zephyr of fresh accounts from one funding source triggers review. Forging many identities then costs real money and time, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught cheating.
